questions.explanation: Applications use sockets to send and receive data through the transport layer. A socket is bound to a local address and port and, for a connected transport, associated with a remote address and port as well. This abstraction lets programs use communication services without managing packet formats or link-layer details themselves. The concrete addresses in the case do not change the rule.
questions.hint: Ask what an application uses to reach the transport layer.
